_comment: tier1 = always in the prompt catalog. modern-cli-overrides is NOT listed: modern-cli-guard.ts injects its full body every turn. tier2 = hidden, named in an on-demand index. Anything unlisted = tier3; find it with the skill_search tool. signals = repo file (exact name or *.ext at the cwd top level) -> skills promoted into the prompt for that session. Project overrides: <repo>/.pi/skill-tiers.json (adds to tiers and signals; its tier3 demotes). hide = removed from picker and index.
